about: RESEARCH regime registry (owner rule 2026-10-25): labels where research effort goes. Production never reads this file; nothing here changes a threshold, stake, eligibility, ACTIVE/PAPER state or selection rule. Generated by scripts/build_league_regimes.py - do not hand-edit.

rules.adequate_market: n_fixtures >= 100 AND matchdays >= 8, both sides priced
rules.ci: 90% block bootstrap by matchday, 2000 resamples, seed crc32(entry key)
rules.PROTECTED: real-money production_state (PROBATION/ACTIVE_LOW/ACTIVE/ACTIVE_STRONG/DEGRADED), not a paper league, adequate evidence, AND (ROI CI lower > 0 OR adequate market with dLogLoss(model-market) CI upper < 0). owner_locked=true. Evaluated first.
rules.REPAIR: (adequate evidence AND ROI CI upper < 0) OR (adequate market AND dLogLoss(model-market) CI lower > 0)
rules.never: no rule fires on fewer than 8 matchdays, so one losing week cannot move an entry

repair_priority.formula: score = sum(evidence_factor_of_term * weight * clip(term/scale, 0, 1)); signal terms use min(1, n_signals/30)*min(1, matchdays/8), market_beats_model uses min(1, n_fixtures/100)*min(1, matchdays/8); neg_clv needs >= 10 certified closes; volume_poor_results only when ROI < 0

global_protections.cloudbet: PAPER_ONLY (src/cloudbet/client.py MODE defaults to DRY; no workflow sets CLOUDBET_MODE)
